How to play

  1. Aim — drag left/right anywhere on the course. Tap the map button (or the mini-map) for a top-down view and tap where you want to go.
  2. Club — pick one from the bottom bar; the number is its full carry in yards.
  3. Swing — tap the big button to start, tap again to set power (the white mark shows what reaches the pin), then tap to strike.
  4. Strike zones — green = pure. Blue = draw (curves left), orange = fade (curves right). Miss them for a hook or slice.
  5. Spin — while the ball is in the air, drag: down = backspin (stops quick), up = topspin (runs out), sideways bends it.
  6. Greens — flowing arrows run downhill; red is steep. With the putter, the dotted line shows how the putt will break at pin distance.
  7. Lies — rough, sand and driver off the deck cost power and control. Water is a one-stroke penalty.
  8. Part swings — under about 85% power, distance and strike get less reliable (wedges are designed for it). A low chip with the 5i, 7W or hybrid from near the green is an easy bump-and-run.
  9. Club levels — every shot earns XP for that club. Levels 1–10 take distance, accuracy and spin from 90% up to 110%, and unlock special shots: Knock-down (Lv 3), Flop with SW/LW (Lv 4), Draw/Fade (Lv 6), Power drive with DR/3W (Lv 8). Tap the shot-type button above your clubs to pick one. New levels kick in from the next hole.
  10. Trees — they're solid. Trunks knock the ball back; leafy branches swallow it and drop it underneath. Go over or around.
  11. Firm greens — woods and long irons skip through fast greens; wedges and the 7 wood hold them.
